decision.explanation: The question asks for when the Los Angeles Olympics were held. The sources explicitly mention two distinct events hosted in Los Angeles: the 1932 Summer Olympics (held July 30–August 14, 1932) and the upcoming 2028 Summer Olympics (scheduled July 21–August 6, 2028). Both years and their specific date ranges are valid answers corresponding to distinct referents. The candidate '1984' (C4) is rejected because while the 1984 Olympics were held in Los Angeles, the provided source texts do not contain any information stating the 1984 games were held in Los Angeles; D5S2 mentions venues for the 1984 games but does not link them to the city of Los Angeles in the text provided, making it unsupported by the supplied context. The existing R5 answers cover all supported instances found in the text.
